external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Superintendent Dr. Chala Holland and the Board of Education partnered with Catalyst for Educational Change (CEC) to develop a new Strategic Plan for District 113, which was approved in June of 2025. With input from students, staff, families and community partners, the plan establishes a clear roadmap for the future, reflecting our shared vision, embracing collaboration, and ensuring every student benefits from an equitable and exceptional educational experience.

To guide this work, District 113 partnered with Catalyst for Educational Change (CEC), a team with deep experience in educational equity and systems change. Together, we convened a diverse Strategic Plan Committee made up of students, staff, families, municipal leaders, elementary district partners and Board representatives.
